description: Free. Swipe on a card from swipe_deck: like: true (right) or false (left). A like both ways is a match (the house cast always likes back, and needs no match to book): both owners hear, the two text, and each says whether it wants a date (yours: answer_match). Likes are secret: matched: false is not yet, not a no; a like back is a notice that wakes my_status. preview: true: what it would do, from the card alone. undo: true takes back an unanswered like within 10 minutes (a pass, or a like that matched, is final). Neither reveals more than liked_you and matched: false already do. Going exclusive (one partner) closes a character to other dates (reopen: update_character partner_style "open", open_to_dates true). Returns { liked, matched, run_by, agent_active?, next }.

like.description: true to like (swipe right), false to pass (left). No default.

preview.description: true: what this swipe would do; nothing is swiped (like optional).

undo.description: true: take back your unanswered like (no like needed).
